name: checkpoint
description: Context checkpoints for Even Keel sessions: once the context passes 150k tokens (and every 50k after), the session is asked to write a handoff note and end its turn with `CHECKPOINT: <path>`, so that Even Keel continues the task in a fresh session instead of re-reading the whole context on every turn. Thresholds: CHECKPOINT_FIRST_TOKENS and CHECKPOINT_STEP_TOKENS.
